goal: Lackluster Plus+ is a TV-channels web app served on the home network. This plan builds a small Android app for Fire TV sticks and TCL Fire TVs that shows that page full screen and is driven by the TV remote. The build tools (build_apk.py, no Gradle) and the artwork are already in the project; the plan adds the manifest, two small resource files and one Java class.
rules: The package is ai.esteef.lacklusterplus and the only activity is ai.esteef.lacklusterplus.MainActivity. Names, ids, strings and key names are the ones in the brief and the spec, spelled exactly.
No new permissions beyond android.permission.INTERNET. No network calls of the app's own: the WebView loads the page and nothing else talks to anything.
Nothing personal is stored except the server address the person typed (SharedPreferences "lacklusterplus", key "server") and the page size (key "page_width").
The brand stays: Lackluster Plus+, Philibert TV, by Esteef.Ai. Dark background #0A0C10.
Where the brief gives code 'exactly', copy it as it is: it was run on a real Fire TV.
conventions: Java 8 source level, one class, only android.* and java.* (no AndroidX, no libraries, no Kotlin, no XML layouts: views are made in code).
Build and check your work with: .venv\Scripts\python.exe build_apk.py  - it prints the Java compiler's errors with file and line. A task is not done while this fails.
Run a task's test with: .venv\Scripts\python.exe tests\<file>.py (it builds the app itself and prints PASS/FAIL lines).
Never edit build_apk.py, make_art.py or anything under app/res/drawable-* and app/res/mipmap-*: they are given.
Anonymous inner classes, not lambdas (the project compiles with -source 8 against android.jar; keep to what the given code uses).
Scratch files and experiments go in the system temp folder, never in the project folder.

tasks.title: The app builds, a Fire TV lists it, and it opens the page
tasks.brief:
Make the smallest app that a Fire TV lists and that opens the Lackluster Plus+ page full screen. Three new files and one class. (The address screen comes in T02, the remote's keys and the TV size in T03: do not write them now.)

A. app/AndroidManifest.xml - exactly this:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- Lackluster Plus+ (Philibert TV, by Esteef.Ai): the Fire TV / Android TV app. It is the web app in a full-screen frame. -->
<manifest xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    package="ai.esteef.lacklusterplus"
    android:versionCode="3"
    android:versionName="1.2">

    <uses-sdk android:minSdkVersion="22" android:targetSdkVersion="34" />

    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.INTERNET" />

    <!-- a TV has no touch screen; without these two lines a TV will not list the app -->
    <uses-feature android:name="android.hardware.touchscreen" android:required="false" />
    <uses-feature android:name="android.software.leanback" android:required="false" />

    <application
        android:label="@string/app_name"
        android:icon="@drawable/banner"
        android:banner="@drawable/banner"
        android:theme="@style/AppTheme"
        android:hardwareAccelerated="true"
        android:usesCleartextTraffic="true"
        android:allowBackup="false">

        <activity
            android:name=".MainActivity"
            android:exported="true"
            android:launchMode="singleTask"
            android:configChanges="orientation|screenSize|smallestScreenSize|screenLayout|keyboard|keyboardHidden|navigation|uiMode">
            <intent-filter>
                <action android:name="android.intent.action.MAIN" />
                <category android:name="android.intent.category.LAUNCHER" />
                <category android:name="android.intent.category.LEANBACK_LAUNCHER" />
            </intent-filter>
        </activity>
    </application>
</manifest>

B. app/res/values/strings.xml - exactly this:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<resources>
    <string name="app_name">Lackluster Plus+</string>
    <string name="byline">Philibert TV, by Esteef.Ai</string>
    <!-- what the address box shows on first launch; the person can change it -->
    <string name="default_server">http://192.168.0.184:9191</string>
</resources>

C. app/res/values/styles.xml - exactly this:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<resources>
    <color name="bg">#0A0C10</color>
    <style name="AppTheme" parent="@android:style/Theme.DeviceDefault.NoActionBar.Fullscreen">
        <item name="android:windowBackground">@color/bg</item>
    </style>
</resources>

D. app/src/ai/esteef/lacklusterplus/MainActivity.java - `public class MainActivity extends Activity` in package ai.esteef.lacklusterplus. In this task it has:
 1. Fields: `FrameLayout root; WebView web; String server = "";` and constants `static final String PREFS = "lacklusterplus"; static final String KEY_SERVER = "server"; static final String UA_MARK = "LacklusterPlusTV/1.0"; static final int BG = Color.parseColor("#0A0C10");`
 2. onCreate: keep the screen on (`getWindow().addFlags(WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON)`); make `root` (a FrameLayout with background BG) the content view; make `web` (background BG), add it to root with MATCH_PARENT both ways; call `setUpWeb()`; read the saved address: `server = getSharedPreferences(PREFS, MODE_PRIVATE).getString(KEY_SERVER, "");` and if it is empty use `getString(R.string.default_server)`; then `load()`.
 3. `isTv()` - exactly:
    boolean isTv() {
        UiModeManager ui = (UiModeManager) getSystemService(Context.UI_MODE_SERVICE);
        if (ui != null && ui.getCurrentModeType() == Configuration.UI_MODE_TYPE_TELEVISION) return true;
        return getPackageManager().hasSystemFeature("amazon.hardware.fire_tv")
                || getPackageManager().hasSystemFeature("android.software.leanback");
    }
 4. `setUpWeb()`: on `web.getSettings()`: setJavaScriptEnabled(true), setDomStorageEnabled(true), setMediaPlaybackRequiresUserGesture(false), setSupportMultipleWindows(false), setMixedContentMode(WebSettings.MIXED_CONTENT_COMPATIBILITY_MODE); `if (isTv()) s.setUserAgentString(s.getUserAgentString() + " " + UA_MARK);` then `CookieManager.getInstance().setAcceptCookie(true);` and `web.setWebViewClient(new WebViewClient() { ... })` whose `shouldOverrideUrlLoading(WebView v, String url)` returns false (every link stays in this frame).
 5. `load()`: `web.loadUrl(server + "/"); web.requestFocus();`
 6. onPause: `web.onPause(); CookieManager.getInstance().flush();`  onResume: `web.onResume();`  onDestroy: `root.removeView(web); web.destroy();` then super.
Then run build_apk.py until it prints `built ...apk`.
